Steps.1: Check on schematic that the feedback resistors of the DC/DC converter have the correct value to achieve a voltage of 5V at the output (Vout = 0.8 (1 + R13/R14)).
Steps.2: Connect the hw_DAA to a DAA CS harness.
Steps.3: Connect the power supply to the DAA CS harness power input, using a DC power connector, banana cables, and crocodile clips (according to the attached diagram).
Steps.4: Switch on the power supply source.
Steps.5: Set 6.5V and 3A on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.6: Turn on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.8: Set up the multimeter as voltmeter. Ensure it is set to Auto-Range, Run/Hold and DC Voltage.
Steps.9: Measure with the multimeter probes if the voltage is 5V at the C20 pads (bottom of the hw_DAA).
Steps.10: Repeat the measurements with different voltages at the power supply source: 12V, 24V and 36V (using CH1 and CH2 of the power supply source connected in serial).
